automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.rule: Only public sources with a visible publication or update date strictly after the start and no later than the end qualify.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The public harness documentation was updated October 29 and describes a harness as owning prompt construction, model and tool orchestration, message persistence, streaming, recovery, and lifecycle extension points.

leaf_implications.docs/wiki/application-patterns/agent-har: Keep the local component inventory explicit and independently inspectable; do not reduce harness architecture to model selection.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/context-architecture/thin-cont: Treat prompt construction, memory, retrieved context, and per-turn instructions as separately routed inputs with traceable ownership.

qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest only the local component and routing implications; framework background remains upstream-owned.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: The public recovery page was updated October 27 and documents bounded recovery, retry exhaustion, terminal behavior, and recovery-event observability.

leaf_implications.docs/wiki/application-patterns/agent-ses: A recoverable session needs an explicit retry budget, terminal state, incident identifier, and observable recovery events.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/application-patterns/agent-har: Recovery, persistence, and observability should remain separate harness components with evidence rather than implicit reliability claims.

qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use as public practice evidence only; no framework-specific local page is warranted.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced assisted permissions on October 26: classified safe actions may proceed while other command, filesystem, or URL requests still require approval; enterprise policy can constrain available modes and defaults.

leaf_implications.docs/wiki/governance-and-risk/agent-gove: Record permission mode, policy source, exceptions, and approval evidence as enforceable controls rather than relying on a permissive default.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/adoption-and-operating-model/a: Name the owner of defaults, policy exceptions, and approval review for each agent environment.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/retrieval-and-tools/mcp-scoped: Treat filesystem, command, and URL access as separately scoped operations with retained approval evidence.

qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Vendor feature details belong upstream; retain only the approval and accountable-ownership practice.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced verified MCP connectors on October 28 that can be connected once and reused across supported clients; enterprise allowlists and service-side administrator enablement can still apply.

leaf_implications.docs/wiki/retrieval-and-tools/mcp-scoped: A reusable connection must preserve service owner, allowlist status, sign-in scope, and administrator enablement evidence.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/retrieval-and-tools/rag-proven: External context should preserve source, connection, and authority metadata before it enters a retrieval or prompt path.

qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Do not duplicate connector or MCP product background in the downstream wiki.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced October 28 repository plugin defaults and enterprise controls; repository settings can register marketplaces and defaults, while enterprise policy can require, block, or restrict named plugins and sources.

leaf_implications.docs/wiki/retrieval-and-tools/portable-a: Separate repository recommendations from enforced policy, and record the approved source and enforceable control owner.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/coding-practices/repository-co: Treat repository configuration as an auditable input to review behavior, but retain independent verification because defaults are not enforcement.

qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Keep the local page focused on recommendation-versus-enforcement and provenance boundaries.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced October 28 cloud sessions that can resume across clients, use ephemeral sandboxes with saved snapshots, draw from shared compute entitlement, and inherit managed permissions and MCP allowlists.

leaf_implications.docs/wiki/adoption-and-operating-model/a: Attribute cloud-agent cost by session, execution environment, entitlement meter, and accepted outcome rather than treating a pooled balance as a productivity result.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/application-patterns/agent-ses: A resumable session must retain a bounded recovery record and distinguish environment snapshots from application-level evidence.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/coding-practices/multi-reviewe: Cross-client agent work still requires independent review and ordinary repository checks before a change is accepted.

qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: The product announcement is upstream-owned; only portable cost, recovery, and verification implications should be ingested.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Anthropic published research on October 27 reporting that experts can change judgment after agent advice; the study frames independent review as weak when the reviewer's judgment is already shaped by the agent.

leaf_implications.docs/wiki/verification-and-evals/agent-e: Preserve independent comparison runs and evidence before attributing a failure or success to an agent recommendation.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/verification-and-evals/agent-a: Keep baseline selection, acceptance criteria, and final approval independent from the optimization agent's proposed framing.
leaf_implications.docs/wiki/governance-and-risk/agent-inci: Incident review should identify whether agent output influenced the initial human judgment and retain an independent evidence path.

qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Use the research as a local independence-of-review implication, not as a broad model or company page.

excluded_candidates.reason: Boundary-only date: not visibly later than the start timestamp.
Documentation page lacked a visible update date, so it cannot qualify.

overall_follow_up_note: Raw-only watch: normal ingest should decide whether these local-practice implications warrant page changes. Broad vendor, product, framework, protocol, and research background remains upstream-owned.
